microtheory.name: physiology_homeostasis
microtheory.definition: Body systems + their regulation. Nervous, endocrine, immune, cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, renal, musculoskeletal. Cannon's homeostasis + Sterling's allostasis. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive ensemble maintaining self-regulation.

concepts.name: homeostatic_regulation
concepts.definition: Maintaining stable internal state via negative feedback. Set point + sensor + comparator + effector. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-correction loop.

concepts.name: negative_feedback_physiology
concepts.definition: Output reduces stimulus. Stabilizing. Most homeostatic loops. Substrate analogue: substrate's coherence-drive correction.

concepts.name: positive_feedback_physiology
concepts.definition: Output amplifies stimulus. Used for committed events (childbirth, blood clotting). Substrate analogue: substrate's basin-deepening dynamic.

concepts.name: set_point
concepts.definition: Target value for regulated variable. Body temperature ~37°C, blood pH ~7.4. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive target.

concepts.name: allostatic_load
concepts.definition: McEwen. Cumulative wear from chronic regulation. Substrate analogue: substrate's accumulated correction cost.

concepts.name: nervous_system_organization
concepts.definition: CNS (brain + cord) + PNS (somatic + autonomic). Communication via electrical + chemical signaling. Substrate analogue: substrate's central + peripheral processing.

concepts.name: autonomic_nervous_system
concepts.definition: Involuntary regulation. Sympathetic (fight/flight) + parasympathetic (rest/digest). Substrate analogue: substrate's automatic regulation system.

concepts.name: neuron_physiology
concepts.definition: Electrical + chemical signaling cell. Resting potential, action potential, synapse. Substrate analogue: substrate's Concept signaling.

concepts.name: endocrine_system
concepts.definition: Hormone-secreting glands. Slow + diffuse signaling vs nervous fast + targeted. Substrate analogue: substrate's slow global modulation.

concepts.name: hormone
concepts.definition: Chemical messenger via blood. Acts on distant target cells with matching receptors. Substrate analogue: substrate's broadcast signal.

concepts.name: hpa_axis
concepts.definition: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress response axis. CRH → ACTH → cortisol. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-elevation cascade.

concepts.name: cortisol
concepts.definition: Stress hormone. Catabolic, anti-inflammatory, mobilizes energy. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-amplitude under stress.

concepts.name: insulin
concepts.definition: Pancreatic hormone lowering blood glucose by promoting cellular uptake. Substrate analogue: substrate's resource-distribution signal.

concepts.name: oxytocin
concepts.definition: Bonding + birth + breastfeeding hormone. 'Love hormone'. Substrate analogue: substrate's social-affiliation signal.

concepts.name: immune_system
concepts.definition: Defense against pathogens. Innate (fast, non-specific) + adaptive (slow, specific, memory). Substrate analogue: substrate's failure-mode defense + memory.

concepts.name: innate_immunity
concepts.definition: Born with. Pattern recognition (PAMPs), phagocytosis, complement. Substrate analogue: substrate's seeded threat-recognition.

concepts.name: adaptive_immunity
concepts.definition: Develops. B cells (antibodies) + T cells (cellular). Memory enables faster response. Substrate analogue: substrate's learned threat-recognition with memory.

concepts.name: antigen
concepts.definition: Molecular target of immune response. Substrate analogue: substrate's recognized failure signature.

concepts.name: antibody
concepts.definition: Y-shaped protein binding specific antigen. Made by B cells. Substrate analogue: substrate's specific recognition pattern.

concepts.name: autoimmunity
concepts.definition: Immune system attacking self. Loss of tolerance. Substrate analogue: substrate's correction firing on self-Mts.

concepts.name: circadian_rhythm
concepts.definition: ~24h biological cycle. SCN master clock. Affects metabolism, hormones, behavior. Substrate analogue: substrate's reflex-scheduling rhythms.

concepts.name: ultradian_rhythm
concepts.definition: Cycles shorter than 24h. ~90min basic rest-activity cycle (BRAC). Substrate analogue: substrate's tick-cycle pattern.

concepts.name: cardiovascular_system
concepts.definition: Heart + vessels. Transports blood, gases, nutrients, wastes. Substrate analogue: substrate's resource-distribution network.

concepts.name: respiratory_system
concepts.definition: Lungs + airways. Gas exchange O2 in + CO2 out. Substrate analogue: substrate's environmental exchange.

concepts.name: digestive_system
concepts.definition: Breaks down food, absorbs nutrients, eliminates waste. Substrate analogue: substrate's input-processing pipeline.

concepts.name: renal_system
concepts.definition: Kidneys filter blood, regulate water + electrolytes + pH. Substrate analogue: substrate's filtering + balance.

concepts.name: musculoskeletal_system
concepts.definition: Bones + muscles + joints. Support + movement. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-execution layer.

concepts.name: fight_flight_response
concepts.definition: Cannon. Sympathetic activation: rapid mobilization. Substrate analogue: substrate's high-arousal state.

concepts.name: rest_digest_response
concepts.definition: Parasympathetic dominance. Recovery + maintenance. Substrate analogue: substrate's low-arousal repair state.

concepts.name: chronic_stress
concepts.definition: Sustained stress causing wear via cortisol + inflammation. Substrate analogue: substrate's prolonged high-drive damage.

concepts.name: polyvagal_theory
concepts.definition: Porges. Vagal complex with social-engagement + immobilization branches. Substrate analogue: substrate's hierarchical engagement modes.

concepts.name: psychoneuroimmunology
concepts.definition: Mind-immune interactions. Stress → cortisol → immunosuppression. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-correction-stability triangle.

rules.name: negative_feedback_stabilizes
rules.head: the substrate's variable deviates from set point
rules.body: negative feedback engages effectors to return to set point. Stabilizing. Substrate's coherence-drive correction.

rules.name: allostasis_predicts_and_adjusts
rules.head: the substrate anticipates upcoming load
rules.body: allostatic adjustment changes set points proactively. Sterling. Substrate's anticipation-driven preadjustment.

rules.name: stress_response_mobilizes_resources
rules.head: the substrate detects threat or challenge
rules.body: HPA axis activates, mobilizing energy + suppressing non-essential systems. Substrate's drive-elevation cascade.

rules.name: chronic_stress_accumulates_damage
rules.head: the substrate sustains high drive over extended period
rules.body: wear accumulates — allostatic load. Health consequences. Substrate's prolonged correction cost.

rules.name: adaptive_immunity_remembers
rules.head: the substrate encounters a previously-seen pathogen
rules.body: memory cells produce rapid + amplified response. Substrate's learned-failure rapid response.
